_comment: Per-opportunity config for bidkit. Copy to <opportunity-id>/opportunity.json. All paths are relative to the opportunity folder (the directory containing this file) unless absolute. Keys prefixed with _ are ignored.
title: Example Records Management System RFP
_solicitation_number: The agency's own number as printed on the RFP. bidkit.portal searches the portal with it when the email linked only the portal's front door; bidkit.brief uses it in research queries.
_source_types: source.type is 'email' (filed by bidkit.inbox), 'fga' (filed by bidkit.fga file from the sourcing portal — then a `sourcing` block records the portal id/url and there is no initial-email/email.md), or 'manual'.

format._comment: Rendering + verification rules copied from the RFP's format section.

fonts._comment: Real TTF files for the required family. macOS Supplemental paths shown.

workbooks._comment: Requirement-style workbooks use the uniform row model (cols). control_tab/control_range give the allowed dropdown vocabulary. placeholders are template strings that must not survive in a filled copy. Form-style workbooks (label + value grids: reference/deployment/support histories) set form_style: true, need no cols, are filled with `xlsx_fill --cells`, and skip the blank-response check (completeness is a human judgment).

forms._comment: Flat PDFs to sign. fields map a logical name to the printed label text that anchors it. page is 1-based.

signer._comment: Values overlaid on forms. Leave date empty until send day. signature_image optional (typed signature used if absent).

redact._comment: Resume scrubbing. domain builds the replacement email <firstname>@<domain>.
